items.title: 许可证已生效：自 v1.8.1 起改为 AGPL-3.0（此前为 MIT）
items.body: 自 v1.8.1 起本仓库整体采用 AGPL-3.0；v1.8.0 及更早版本维持 MIT。日常使用、自部署不受影响；任何二次利用（含网络服务形式）需同协议开源。
items.titleEn: License in effect: AGPL-3.0 starting with v1.8.1 (previously MIT)
items.bodyEn: The repository ships under AGPL-3.0 since v1.8.1; releases up to v1.8.0 remain MIT. Everyday use and self-hosting are unaffected; any reuse — including as a network service — must stay under the same license.

items.title: Qoder 排队机制与账号风控说明
items.body: 部分 Qoder 账号持续排队（10605）是官方账号级风控慢速队列；订阅套餐有专属优先通道。10Router 自动识别并冷却顺延至其他可用账号。
items.titleEn: Qoder queue throttle and account rate-limit explained
items.bodyEn: Continuous queueing on some Qoder accounts (10605) is the official per-account slow lane; subscribed plans get a priority lane. 10Router detects it and fails over automatically.

items.title: 「余额优先」修好了：此前设过不生效的，现在会真的生效
items.body: 详情页的「小额优先 / 大额优先」以前会把选择悄悄丢掉，还会被全局「轮询」压过——现在真的生效，运行日志会记一行选中结果可核对。余额为 0 或已透支的号也不再被「小额优先」顶到最前，改为沉到队尾。QuWork、DuMate、灵犀、DeepAI、AutoClaw 双端、Clixad、FreePi 七家新出现这个入口。（随下一版发布，当前 v1.8.3）
items.titleEn: Balance-first scheduling is fixed — what you set before now actually applies
items.bodyEn: "Lowest / highest balance first" used to vanish on save and could lose to a global round-robin — it now sticks, and the run log names the account picked. Zero or overdrawn accounts no longer lead a lowest-first queue. QuWork, DuMate, Lingxi, DeepAI, AutoClaw (both), Clixad and FreePi gained the entry. Ships with the next release (current: v1.8.3).

items.title: 组合：排前渠道假死秒级让位，轮询按时间窗粘滞
items.body: 组合排前的成员若上游只挂连接不回应，以前最坏干等约 249 秒才换下一个，客户端超时先到就像整个组合卡死；现在走专门的短探测预算（默认 12 秒，COMBO_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS 可调），连续两次全无应答的成员往后垫但不剔除。轮询也改为活跃时段固定同一模型、空闲超窗（默认 5 分钟）才轮换。（随下一版发布，当前 v1.8.3）
items.titleEn: Combos: a dead channel yields in seconds, rotation sticks within a time window
items.bodyEn: A leading combo member that only holds the socket used to burn up to ~249s before the next one — your client timed out first and the combo looked frozen. A 12s probe budget (COMBO_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS) fixes that; a member with two no-answers is deferred, not dropped. Round-robin now keeps one model while traffic is active and rotates after an idle window. Ships with the next release (current: v1.8.3).

items.title: 四条免费车道：Junie Lite / AtomCode / Clixad / FreePi
items.body: Junie（JetBrains）免费账号即可用 Junie Lite；AtomCode 登录自动领 Lite 体验版（每 5 小时 300 次）；Clixad 每日 12 万 credits、8 款免费模型；FreePi 每日 4000 credits。四家都带额度卡。须知：都是各家客户端自己的接口，上游改策略可能失效或触发风控，只用自己的账号登录。（随下一版发布，当前 v1.8.3）
items.titleEn: Four free lanes: Junie Lite / AtomCode / Clixad / FreePi
items.bodyEn: Junie's free lane opens to any JetBrains account; AtomCode auto-claims a Lite trial (300 requests per 5 hours); Clixad grants 120k credits a day over 8 free models; FreePi 4k. All four carry a quota card. Notice: these are the clients' own endpoints — policy changes can break them or trip risk control. Use your own account only. Ships with the next release (current: v1.8.3).

items.title: Qoder 双端可用 HungerG（0x 免费）；CodeBuddy 限免临近截止
items.body: 官方 0x 的 HungerG（1M 上下文、可读图）此前只在桌面客户端目录里出现，现在 Qoder 国内版与国际版都能选，国际版另补 Fast（0.6x）；GLM-5.4 也上了 Qoder、CodeBuddy CN、千问办公国内版与 ZCode 免费线。另有一件现在就来得及：CodeBuddy CN 的 Hy4 flash 限免只到 11 月 30 日，到期徽章自动回落原价。（新增行随下一版发布，当前 v1.8.3；限免现行版本就有）
items.titleEn: HungerG (0x) opens on both Qoder lines; a CodeBuddy promo is about to close
items.bodyEn: The official 0x HungerG (1M context, vision) lived only in the desktop app catalog — Qoder CN and intl both offer it now, with Fast (0.6x) added to intl; GLM-5.4 landed on Qoder, CodeBuddy CN, QwenWork CN and the ZCode free line. Also time-sensitive: CodeBuddy CN Hy4 flash is free only until November 30, then the badge falls back on its own. (New rows ship with the next release, current is v1.8.3; the promo is live on what you run now.)

items.title: 四家扫码 / 签到型供应商：QuWork、商汤小浣熊、OrcaTerm、AutoClaw
items.body: QuWork（+86 短信、积分卡、每日签到、兑换码激活）、商汤小浣熊（微信扫码，积分按任务与邀请自动发）、OrcaTerm（腾讯云终端扫码，支持工具调用与读图）、AutoClaw 双端（智谱，GLM-5.3 Flash 免费）。两处要动手：QuWork 拒绝非中国大陆 IP（405），海外服务器请给该连接配国内代理；AutoClaw 是逆向桌面端接口，勿与桌面端同登。（随下一版发布，当前 v1.8.3）
items.titleEn: Four QR / check-in providers: QuWork, Raccoon, OrcaTerm, AutoClaw
items.bodyEn: QuWork (+86 SMS, credits, daily check-in, code redemption), SenseNova Raccoon (WeChat QR, credits from tasks and invites), OrcaTerm (Tencent Cloud terminal QR, tools and vision) and AutoClaw both lines (Zhipu, GLM-5.3 Flash free). Two actions: QuWork refuses non-mainland-China IPs (405) — proxy that connection if your server is overseas; AutoClaw is a reverse-engineered desktop API — don't sign into the desktop app too. Ships with the next release (current: v1.8.3).

items.title: Amazon Quick：没有 API Key，粘一段 Copy as cURL 即用
items.body: AWS 的办公 agent（Q Business 后继）没有公开 chat API，调用走你已登录的 quick.aws.com 浏览器会话：在网页聊天发一句话，F12 找一条 ws-rpc 请求 Copy as cURL，整段粘进连接框即可。模型是 fast / smart / advanced 三档，消耗套餐的月度 agent 小时。会话不能自动续期，测试变红就重贴一段。（随下一版发布，当前 v1.8.3）
items.titleEn: Amazon Quick: no API key — paste one Copy as cURL and go
items.bodyEn: AWS's workplace agent (successor to Q Business) has no public chat API, so calls ride your signed-in quick.aws.com session: send one message in the web chat, copy a ws-rpc request from DevTools as cURL, paste it into the connection box. Three tiers (fast / smart / advanced), billed against monthly agent hours. The session can't be refreshed — re-paste when the test goes red. Ships with the next release (current: v1.8.3).

items.title: Numes 与 Atlas Cloud：两个 OpenAI 兼容网关，Numes 带 :free 与 BTC 余额
items.body: Numes 是多家独立供应商的推理市场，余额可选美元或比特币（建 Key 时固定），模型 ID 与 OpenRouter 同形态，带 :free 后缀的完全免费（GLM-5.3、DeepSeek V4.1 Flash、Kimi K3.1 Pro 等），预置 34 款、其余填 ID 即用。Atlas Cloud 是纯 API Key 接入的兼容网关。（随下一版发布，当前 v1.8.3）
items.titleEn: Numes and Atlas Cloud: two OpenAI-compatible gateways, Numes with :free and a BTC balance
items.bodyEn: Numes is an inference marketplace across independent providers — balance in USD or bitcoin (fixed at key creation), OpenRouter-shaped ids, and :free models that cost nothing (GLM-5.3, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Kimi K3.1 Pro); 34 preloaded, the rest work by id. Atlas Cloud is a plain API-key gateway. Ships with the next release (current: v1.8.3).

items.title: Trae 免费账号实际只有豆包可用；本轮清单数值未经 live 验证
items.body: Trae 国际线按官方客户端重排清单，除 Auto Mode 与豆包 Seed-2.1-Turbo 外全部带锁（需 Lite / Pro / Pro+ / Ultra），免费账号的真实可达面现在在徽章上如实可见；国内版新增三行带锁模型并改正 DeepSeek 倍率与闲时口径（北京时间 22:00–次日 8:00）。Trae 没有可读目录接口，本轮数值来自客户端截图，未经 live 验证。（随下一版发布，当前 v1.8.3）
items.titleEn: On a free Trae account only Doubao is reachable; this catalog round isn't live-verified
items.bodyEn: Trae intl now follows the official list, everything locked except Auto Mode and Doubao Seed-2.1-Turbo (Lite / Pro / Pro+ / Ultra), so a free account's real reach finally shows in the badges; CN gained three locked rows plus corrected DeepSeek rates and off-peak window (22:00–08:00 Beijing). Trae exposes no readable catalog, so these figures come from screenshots and aren't live-verified. Ships with the next release (current: v1.8.3).
